Cache and Visualization

FileCache needs the JLD2 extension (using JLD2), and detections! needs a Makie backend.

VisualGeometryToolkitFeatures.FileCache — Type
FileCache{D}

Wrapper around an open file-backed key-value store. The concrete backend D is determined by the extension (e.g., JLD2).

source
VisualGeometryToolkitFeatures.cache_key — Method
cache_key(args...) -> String

Compute a stable hex-encoded SHA-256 cache key from arbitrary arguments. The caller decides what goes in; this function just hashes.

Example

key = cache_key(board_uid, model_hash, cutoff, patch_size)
get!(cache, key) do ... end
source
VisualGeometryToolkitFeatures.close_cache — Method
close_cache(cache)

Close the cache file handle. No-op for nothing.

source
VisualGeometryToolkitFeatures.open_cache — Method
open_cache(path) -> FileCache or nothing

Open a persistent cache file. Returns nothing if path is nothing or the file cannot be opened (logs a warning).

Requires a backend extension (e.g., using JLD2).

source
VisualGeometryToolkitFeatures.detections! — Function
detections!(ax, dets::AbstractVector{<:Detection};
            cutoff=1.0, color_by=nothing, colormap=:viridis, kwargs...)

Overlay detections as batched ellipse boundaries (VisualGeometryToolkitCore's ellipses!).

color_by selects the stroke coloring:

  • nothing — constant strokecolor
  • :response — |metadata.response| through colormap
  • an AbstractVector{<:Real} — explicit per-detection values

Requires Makie.
